evidence.why: Exact increment, survival guard and paired callbacks.

facts.rationale: Corrects the ambiguous 24-update lifetime claim while retaining the supported callback behavior.
facts.value: State 0 aligns the model to xDE8, increments xDF4, and continues only while the incremented age is at most 24 and the ground partner reciprocally links back. Missing or mismatched linkage terminates immediately. With no intervening reset, a zero age expires on the 25th animation callback. Surface refresh and reflection reset age, so this is not an absolute total-lifetime bound. Physics clears velocity; collision returns false; reflection restarts state 0.

evidence.why: Accepted surface updates refresh the air component.

facts.rationale: Separates immediate linkage failure from delayed refresh-age expiration instead of describing both as sustained loss of terrain linkage.
facts.value: Maintains the orientation and continuity of Thunder Jolt's linked air-kind component during terrain travel. Accepted ground-controller surface updates refresh its direction and age. Loss of reciprocal object linkage ends it immediately; lack of further refreshes ends it when its incremented age exceeds 24.

facts.rationale: Makes the boundary and reset-relative lifetime explicit.
facts.value: Orients the linked Thunder Jolt component from its stored surface direction, increments its refresh-age counter, and performs terminal cleanup if the incremented age exceeds 24 or the reciprocal ground link is invalid. Starting at zero without further resets, it returns false for 24 callbacks and true on the 25th; invalid linkage can terminate it sooner.

evidence.why: Constructor order, setup and lifetime checks.

facts.rationale: Corrects the absolute lifetime claim and distinguishes debug display configuration from ownership registration.
facts.value: Allocation failure returns NULL without article-specific initialization. Success clears command variables, stores the ground partner, resets xDF4, sets model Y rotation and invokes post-creation setup, which clears generic flags, enters state 0 and configures debug collision display from the owner. The constructor then stores the owner. Subsequent animation requires reciprocal linkage and an incremented refresh age at most 24; terrain refresh and reflection can reset that age, so the component has no fixed 24-callback total lifetime.

evidence.why: Exact age guard and all interaction outcomes.

facts.rationale: Corrects the unit-level lifetime boundary and preserves the full terminal-versus-reflected distinction.
facts.value: Defines one air-kind motion state. Animation increments refresh age and terminates when it exceeds 24 or reciprocal linkage is absent or inconsistent; from zero, timeout occurs on the 25th callback without another reset. Surface updates and reflection reset age. Damage dealt, clank, absorption, shield hit and shield bounce reset hitboxes, unlink the pair and return true. Reflection instead reanchors and reorients the component, rebuilds planar direction, resets age and restarts state 0 with a false return.

evidence.why: Accessor calls precede guard; setup writes and state request.
Both object accessors directly dereference their argument.

facts.rationale: Corrects a false null-safety guarantee by following accessor expansion and execution order.
facts.value: Ground collision invokes this routine after creating the linked air-kind component and on later accepted surface updates. Each executed setup body copies position, collision and direction, resets age to zero, synchronizes the model and re-enters state 0 with flags 0x12. A valid GObj with null Item userdata skips the body. A null GObj is not a supported no-op input: GET_ITEM and GET_JOBJ dereference it before the explicit guard. Other input pointers and the required model data are not locally validated.

evidence.why: Terrain-contact creation of the linked component.

facts.rationale: Removes an unsupported 10-percent aerial-shot attribution caused by conflating the Air item kind with aerial firing.
facts.value: Implements the successful damaging-hit cleanup of Thunder Jolt's linked air-kind component: it resets attack state, disconnects the paired ground controller and returns a terminal true result. The controller creates this component at terrain contact; this callback does not establish the damage amount or behavior of an initially fired descending aerial shot.

facts.rationale: Corrects the firing-mode attribution while retaining the supported shield-interaction mapping.
facts.value: Implements the shield-contact response of Thunder Jolt's linked air-kind component, resetting its hitboxes and severing its ground-controller relationship before returning true. This component is created during the controller's terrain-contact transition; its Air kind does not by itself identify an aerially fired projectile.

evidence.why: Ground helper only clears its backlink.

facts.rationale: Replaces generic success and auxiliary-handle wording with the demonstrated cleanup and cross-file lifetime semantics.
facts.value: Handles shield contact by resetting the air component's hitboxes, conditionally clearing the linked ground object's backlink and its own xDD8 link, and returning a terminal true result. An absent link skips reciprocal cleanup; the ground object is not directly destroyed by the unlink helper.
